AC0000.justification: Reports that an analyzer crashed, not a defect in the code; always visible, never blocking.

AC0001.justification: A list page source table without lookup and drill-down pages leaves users no way to open the record from a field value; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AC0002.justification: A blank single-field key lets a later delete or rename cascade into every unrelated record with an empty relation field; data-loss risk, Warning from Recommended.

AC0003.justification: NotBlank on a key filled by a number series rejects every new record in the client before OnInsert runs; Warning from Essential since detection is heuristic.

AC0004.justification: A direct Confirm call fails at runtime in job queues and web service calls where no UI exists; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

AC0005.justification: Switching the session language by hand risks leaving it switched when the restore is missed or an error interrupts; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0006.justification: Hardcoding the page for document and setup tables opens the wrong variant, for example a quote on the order page; Warning from Recommended.

AC0007.justification: A public install or upgrade codeunit invites other apps to call it, so later cleanup becomes a breaking change; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.

AC0008.justification: Opt-in check that records the per-company storage choice explicitly, since changing it later needs empty tables; Info in Complete only.

AC0009.justification: A permission set caption without a length cap lets translations exceed 30 characters and get truncated in the list; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0010.justification: Objects outside every permission set force administrators to grant access by hand before users can work; Warning from Recommended.

AC0011.justification: Without a caption a user-facing element gets no translation unit and shows the AL identifier in every language; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0012.justification: An integration event in an internal codeunit cannot be subscribed to from other apps, so the extension point is dead; Warning from Recommended.

AC0013.justification: Opt-in check for DropDown and Brick field groups so lookups and tiles show useful fields; Info in Complete only.

AC0014.justification: Tooltip text without closing punctuation is a style lapse against the user assistance guidelines; too cosmetic to advise, a gate from Strict.

AC0015.justification: Field tooltips that do not open with Specifies break the wording convention of the standard application; style, a gate from Strict.

AC0016.justification: A line break escape in a tooltip renders as a literal backslash in the client; visible defect, Warning from Recommended.

AC0017.justification: Tooltips over 200 characters turn a quick hint into a block of text users must read; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0018.justification: An unlocked empty caption adds a blank translation unit that translators must skip in every language; translation hygiene, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0019.justification: A meaningful value at ordinal zero cannot be told apart from the default every new record gets; design advice, a gate from Strict.

AC0020.justification: A token label left translatable can be translated and break the API key or identifier it carries; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

AC0021.justification: Opt-in naming check that marks every locked label as a token; Info in Complete only.

AC0022.justification: A caption on the empty enum value is dead metadata the platform ignores; harmless clutter, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0023.justification: An enum value with an empty caption cannot be picked in dropdowns; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AC0024.justification: A public event publisher freezes its signature as public API while subscribers need no public access; extensibility risk, Warning from Recommended.

AC0025.justification: Assigning the magic number 10 for a line feed hides intent that the Type Helper separators state; readability, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0026.justification: A field kept off every page can still be added and edited through page customization unless its exposure is set; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0027.justification: A locked label whose text equals its name is a token and should say so with its suffix; naming refinement, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0028.justification: A tooltip kept on the page instead of the table field must be copied to every page and goes stale; maintainability, a gate from Strict.

AC0029.justification: A page tooltip that repeats the table field tooltip stops following later table edits; maintainability, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0030.justification: A discarded Get or Find result raises only the generic platform error, often deliberately; noisy advice, Info from Strict.

AC0031.justification: Table access without declared object permissions fails for users who hold only indirect permissions; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0032.justification: Declared permissions the code never uses mislead anyone auditing what the object touches; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0033.justification: Advice that the app ships its own Rest Client handler so its own HTTP setting governs its calls; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.

AC0034.justification: Advice that the app carries its own Telemetry Logger instead of relying on another app of the publisher; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.

LC0000.justification: Only signal that a LinterCop analyzer crashed and checked nothing; always visible, never blocking.

LC0003.justification: A numeric object id compiles silently when the object is renumbered or renamed, hiding drift a name would catch; Warning from Recommended.

LC0007.justification: Reports a maintainability score, not a defect; Info in Complete only.

LC0008.justification: A low maintainability score marks code that is costly to change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0009.justification: Reports a cyclomatic complexity number, not a defect; Info in Complete only.

LC0010.justification: Too many execution paths make a procedure hard to test and change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0019.justification: A field repeating the table data classification keeps the old value when the table changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0020.justification: A control repeating the page application area keeps the old value when the page changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0028.justification: String literals in subscriber arguments break go to definition and references; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0031.justification: LockTable widens locks to every read of the table and disables optimistic reads; advisory because the fix is not mechanical, a gate from Strict.

LC0033.justification: A runtime behind the target only withholds newer language features and is often kept low on purpose for older servers; Info from Recommended.

LC0040.justification: A bare Insert, Modify or Delete hides whether skipping triggers was intended; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0043.justification: Credential held in Text is readable in the debugger and snapshot sessions; Warning from Essential as a security rule.

LC0048.justification: Error with plain Text replaces the message in telemetry with a placeholder, so failures cannot be diagnosed; Warning from Recommended.

LC0052.justification: An internal procedure nobody calls is dead code or a missing call; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0053.justification: An internal procedure used only in its own object exposes more scope than it needs; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0054.justification: The interface prefix contradicts the mandatory AppSource affixes and is opinion elsewhere; None everywhere.

LC0063.justification: Non-canonical API field names force consumers to map fields, but renaming a published field breaks integrations; Info until Complete.

LC0081.justification: Comparing Count with zero scans every matching row where IsEmpty reads one; a performance fix from Recommended.

LC0082.justification: Count equal to one scans every matching row where Find and Next read two; advisory since the rewrite needs judgment, a gate from Strict.

LC0083.justification: Numeric-argument date functions and Format round-trips obscure which part is read; readability advice, a gate from Strict.

LC0086.justification: A misspelled style string compiles and silently drops the styling the user should see; Warning from Recommended.

LC0088.justification: Option values cannot be extended by other apps and invite magic numbers; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0089.justification: Reports a cognitive complexity number, not a defect; Info in Complete only.

LC0089i.justification: One message per complexity increment is noise next to the metric and the threshold rule; None everywhere.

LC0090.justification: Deep nesting makes a procedure hard to read and easy to break three levels down; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0091.justification: A missing or unfinished translation shows source-language text to users in that locale; Warning from Recommended, silent without XLIFF files.

LC0092.justification: Inconsistent identifier naming makes symbol search unreliable and slows review; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0094.justification: A field repeating the object AllowInCustomizations value is redundant noise; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0095.justification: An unused parameter clutters the signature, but removing one from a public procedure breaks dependent apps; Info until Complete.

LC0096.justification: Passing a record to a method already called on it misleads readers about what the method needs; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0097.justification: Mixing exit and named return assignments is a style choice of an opt-in rule; Info in Complete only.

LC0098.justification: A subscriber name that does not encode source and event hides what it reacts to; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0099.justification: An unused subscriber parameter clutters the signature and is safe to drop; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0000.justification: The only sign that the documentation analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.

DC0001.justification: A manual commit without a reason invites a later refactor to remove or copy it blindly; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0002.justification: A write to a calculated field is not stored and looks like a bug unless a comment says why; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0003.justification: A stray semicolon is either leftover code or an undocumented no-op; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0004.justification: Public procedures without XML docs leave callers guessing in IntelliSense; too noisy for most projects below Strict.

DC0005.justification: XML docs that name missing parameters mislead callers in signature help; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0006.justification: Opt-in documentation for internal procedures; Info in Complete only.

DC0007.justification: Public objects without XML docs leave consumers without a stated purpose; too noisy for most projects below Strict.

DC0008.justification: Opt-in documentation for internal objects; Info in Complete only.

DC0009.justification: Published events without XML docs leave subscribers guessing at when they fire; too noisy for most projects below Strict.

DC0010.justification: Opt-in documentation for internal events; Info in Complete only.

FC0000.justification: The only sign that the formatting analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.

FC0001.justification: A semicolon after a procedure header is harmless style noise; advisory below the author default, a gate from Strict.

FC0002.justification: Casing that differs from the declaration is pure style with a code fix; floods legacy code, so a gate from Strict.

FC0003.justification: A call without parentheses reads like a property access; style below the author default, a gate from Strict.

FC0004.justification: Unsorted permission entries cause avoidable merge conflicts and a code fix sorts them; advisory, a gate from Strict.

FC0005.justification: Assignment syntax hides that a method runs; style below the author default, a gate from Strict.

FC0006.justification: Uppercase permission letters wrongly suggest a direct grant but change nothing at runtime; opinion, Warning in Complete.

FC0007.justification: Blank lines between statement blocks are an opt-in layout preference; Info in Complete only.

TA0000.justification: The only sign that the test automation analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.

TA0001.justification: A global procedure in a test codeunit is either a missed test attribute or a misplaced helper; advisory, a gate from Strict.

TA0002.justification: Invoking an action on a part opened on its own fails the test at runtime; Error from Recommended as only test code is hit.

CM0001.justification: A broken or unreadable alcops.json silently falls back to defaults and disables intended rules; Warning at every level.
